Current Mode: {0}
Add a copy of this material to its binder under a new name, for a model of your own to use.
Rename this material. Models refer to their materials by name, so any model using the old name will no longer find it.
Remove this material from its binder. Undo restores it.
A copy of {0} is added to {1}, after the original. A MATBIN's Source Path and key are updated to the new name.
{0} in {1} gets a new name in the same folder. A MATBIN's Source Path and key are updated to the new name.
The material's name, without folder or extension. This is the name a model's material refers to.
The name can't contain folder separators or characters that aren't allowed in file names.
A material named {0} already exists. Models find materials by name, so only one of them could be used.
Models that use this material will no longer find it. Undo restores it until the editor is closed.

This file couldn't be read, so it can't be edited. See the log for the error.
Saving this binder keeps the file unchanged.
Show only materials of chosen kinds, such as emissive, metallic or scrolling.
Showing only materials that are all of: {0}. Click to change.
A material is listed when it is every ticked kind. Kinds are read from the material and shader names, the texture types and the params, so a few may be missed or misread.
Only a colour texture: [A] or [D] materials, or ones whose every texture is an albedo.
Gives off light: emissive or glow shaders (_em in older games), an emissive map or emissive params.
Moves its textures: scroll shaders, or a scroll param that isn't zero.
Blends with what's behind it: a blended blend mode (Blend, Add, Sub and so on), or an alpha or translucent shader.
Cuts holes by alpha: the TexEdge blend mode, or an edge shader (_e, _Edge).
Blends several texture layers: [Mb2], [Multiple], [DetailBlend], _2m or _m, or more than one albedo.
Adds an overlay or detail texture on top: [Ov_N], [Ov_AN], or a detail texture.
Not lit by the scene: NoLight shaders.
Water and ocean shaders, or a water blend mode.
